response.text: The identity lookup confirms the queried gene maps to a well-characterized human receptor tyrosine kinase, with the retrieved accession, protein name, and sequence length all mutually consistent and passing the identity verification check performed. The computed sequence properties, such as the hydropathy index and net charge, describe general physicochemical features of the protein but say nothing about binding, activity, or drug-likeness for any ligand. No docking, potency, or claim-verification metrics were populated in this run, so no statements about molecular interactions, efficacy, or the reliability of any downstream claims can be supported here. Overall, this result establishes protein identity only, not any functional, safety, or clinical conclusion.
